title: Straight-through processing for low-risk auto claims
business_need: Low-complexity auto claims below a modest value currently follow the same manual adjudication path as complex ones. Adjusters spend a large share of their time on claims that almost never require judgement, while genuinely complex claims wait behind them. We want low-risk claims to be assessed and settled without an adjuster touching them, while anything that looks unusual continues to a human as it does today. Customers should see a faster settlement on simple claims, and adjusters should see fewer routine items in their queue.
constraints: Claims data and customer personal information must remain within the country of operation.
An adjuster must be able to review and override any automated settlement decision.
The existing claims intake system remains the system of record and cannot be replaced in this initiative.
Must integrate with the current payments service rather than issuing payments directly.
success_measures: Median settlement time for eligible claims drops from 6 days to under 1 day.
At least 40 percent of eligible claims settle without adjuster involvement within two quarters.
No increase in the rate of settlements later reopened or disputed.
